answer: Saffron-Yarrow Transect: one 3-hour field walk per fake identity. Each identity must wander a 2 km transect and photograph one saffron crocus and one yarrow plant in bloom at GPS-stamped points, filing both in the public iNaturalist record. A verifier re-checks each photo against the species known range and bloom season, and duplicate photos or out-of-range points void the identity. One walk cannot serve many names because each transect GPS track is unique.
